jobs.jd: Data Scientist Build AI That Accelerates Scientific Discovery Do you want your work to help researchers solve humanity’s biggest challenges? At Elsevier, data science is not about building models for the sake of building models. It is about advancing scientific discovery, improving healthcare outcomes, and helping researchers, clinicians, educators, and institutions unlock knowledge that can improve lives around the world. Every day, millions of scientists rely on our products to discover evidence, connect ideas, validate findings, and advance research. As a Data Scientist, your work will directly contribute to the tools and technologies that help accelerate human progress. About the Team As part of a growing team of Data Scientists, you will take on some of the hardest problems in science. This team is building intelligent systems that can reason across scientific publications, research data, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, taxonomies, citations, and content spanning every scientific discipline. About the Role As a Data Scientist at Elsevier, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that power knowledge discovery across the global research ecosystem. You will work with one of the world's richest collections of scientific information, including publications, citations, research datasets, metadata, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and multidisciplinary content spanning every scientific field. This role combines cutting-edge AI with meaningful impact. You will help build intelligent systems that make scientific knowledge more discoverable, trustworthy, connected, and actionable. What You'll Do Design and deploy machine learning, NLP, and generative AI solutions that help researchers discover, understand, and apply scientific knowledge. Build intelligent retrieval, search, recommendation, ranking, and question-answering systems that improve research outcomes. Develop AI systems that connect information across publications, datasets, citations, knowledge graphs, and scientific ontologies. Fine-tune, evaluate, and integrate large language models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems into production environments. Create robust evaluation frameworks that measure quality, reliability, relevance, trustworthiness, and user impact. Build scalable data pipelines and machine learning workflows that support experimentation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Apply the appropriate combination of classical machine learning, deep learning, retrieval, and generative AI techniques to solve complex scientific problems. Collaborate with engineering, product, UX, analytics, and domain experts to transform ambiguous challenges into practical solutions. Contribute clean, maintainable, production-quality Python code and reusable AI components. Continuously improve the capabilities, performance, and real-world value of AI systems that support scientific discovery. What We're Looking For Degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline. Extensive Python programming skills and experience building production-quality data science solutions. Experience with machine learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, feature engineering, and performance optimization. Experience working with large-scale structured, semi-structured, or unstructured datasets. Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, including large language models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and generative AI. Familiarity with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent tools. Experience evaluating AI outputs and improving model quality, reliability, and business impact. Ability to translate complex problems into measurable, data-driven solutions. A genuine passion for advancing science, improving access to knowledge, and using AI to create meaningful real-world impact. Why Join Elsevier Because your work will matter. You will help build AI systems that support researchers, healthcare professionals, educators, and institutions around the world. Your contributions will help people discover critical evidence, uncover new insights, accelerate innovation, and advance scientific progress. This is an opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and meaningful AI problems anywhere—combining world-class data, cutting-edge technology, and a mission dedicated to improving lives through science and knowledge. jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations
jobs.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our team in Revenue Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline sales processes, enhance decision-making, and drive growth. The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member serves as a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function, whether that's SDRs, AEs, Partnerships, or Account Management.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation and operational effectiveness.

 - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting.

 - Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area.

 - Data-Driven Strategy - Oversee analytics and performance analyses across their associated functions. Identify areas of opportunity and acceleration; build dashboards and insights that inform experimentation and guide lever improvement.

 - Reporting & Analytics - Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and enhance team performance.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:



 - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

 - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

 - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

 - 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies

 - Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution.

 - Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps

 - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

 - Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

 - Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.



What we offer

 - High-velocity innovation: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - A truly global team: Collaboration with teammates across 30+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!)

 - Remote first: We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings.

 - Continuous growth: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: PGIM - Investment Analyst, Portfolio Analysis Group
jobs.jd: Job Classification: Investment Management - Investments A GLOBAL FIRM WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world. We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers! If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today. At PGIM, You Can! What you will do The Portfolio Analysis Group (PAG) partners closely with investment teams to provide the analytics and insights that support portfolio construction, risk monitoring, performance analysis, and investment decision-making. Our PAG Analyst Program is a three-year rotational program designed to provide broad exposure across asset classes, investment strategies, and portfolio management teams. Analysts complete one-year rotations across PAG and select partner teams, developing a strong foundation in portfolio analytics while gaining firsthand experience across the investment process. Core rotations may include General Account, Investment Grade, High Yield, Emerging Markets, US/Global Rates & Hedge Fund, Structured Products, and Multi-Sector. Satellite rotations may include CLO Structuring, Structured Products Research, and Investment Risk Management. This incoming Analyst will begin the program aligned to our Structured Products / Asset-Based Finance (ABF) team , where they will work closely with Portfolio Managers and other investment partners to analyze portfolio positioning and performance, monitor risk and client objectives, and deliver actionable insights that support day-to-day portfolio management. This position follows a hybrid work model, with working 3 days in the Newark, NJ office and 2 days remote. What you can expect Analyze portfolio positioning relative to benchmarks, client objectives, risk parameters, and investment goals, identifying changes in exposures and opportunities to improve portfolio alignment. Produce portfolio analytics and performance attribution to help explain investment results and inform portfolio management decisions. Incorporate client guidelines, investment objectives, and risk tolerances into portfolio monitoring, scenario analysis, and portfolio management workflows. Partner with Portfolio Managers, Traders, Risk Managers, Quantitative teams, Credit Research, Client Advisory, technology partners, and senior PAG team members. Support timely market, portfolio, and client analyses while improving recurring reports, analytical tools, and repeatable processes. What you will bring Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of relevant experience in investment management, financial services, portfolio or risk analytics, research, or a related analytical field. Proficiency with Excel and familiarity with investment and data analytics tools such as Bloomberg, Aladdin, SQL, and Python preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear, actionable insights. A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across investment, risk, research, and technology teams. What will set you apart Strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to problem solving. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced investment environment. Exposure to coding best practices, including documentation, version control, testing, peer review, and writing maintainable code. jobs.title: Quantitative Analytics Professional
jobs.jd: At Freddie Mac, our mission of Making Home Possible is what motivates us, and it’s at the core of everything we do. Since our charter in 1970, we have made home possible for more than 90 million families across the country. Join an organization where your work contributes to a greater purpose. Position Overview: Freddie Mac’s Investments & Capital Markets Division is currently seeking a Quantitative Analytics Professional within the Models & Analytics team to be responsible for the creation, development, and execution of analytic models in support of Counterparty Risk Management. The key focus is on exposure measurement driven by market risk factors for various products and counterparty types, but the tasks may also include counterparty credit risk exposure, LGD, and credit rating models. The position encourages continued learning and development across other modeling areas, such as market risk capital, operational loss forecast, prepayment and default, and rates and derivatives. Our Impact: Key focus of this job is the design, development, and implementation of counterparty risk models for a variety of financial institutions, with primary focus on Exposure at Default models. These models support multiple corporate and divisional objectives by providing key inputs into counterparty credit risk management, both at individual counterparty and portfolio levels. Your Impact: Design, code and maintain consistent counterparty risk models (EAD/PD/LGD). Incorporate best practices while simultaneously accounting for the unique characteristics and risks of each financial institution. Collaborate with the Counterparty Credit Risk Management (CCRM) to gain in-depth understanding of various types of financial products (e.g. MBS, CMO, ARM, Whole Loans, Credit Risk Transfer, Insurers) in order to appropriately model unique associated risks Design and code model enhancements to address agreed-upon actions (AUAs) in response to findings from model reviewers, internal auditors, and regulatory examiners Design and produce Performance Monitoring Reports on a regular cadence, respond to inquiries from various stakeholders Periodically review and understand changes in relevant corporate policies, standards and procedures and act as a liaison in associated model implementation validation Understand and comply with all model controls related to models owned by the team Collaborate with the Divisional Model Governance team to ensure compliance with model governance standards Proactively partner with teammates and users to facilitate ideas and keep improving models Qualifications: Master's Degree in quantitative finance, statistics or a related quantitative field Qualifying coursework may include – but not limited to — econometrics, statistics, mathematical programming, optimization, computational methods, simulation, mortgage-backed securities, derivatives pricing, fixed income and term structure of interest rates Must have coursework or work experience developing and implementing financial models, with demonstrable knowledge in quantitative modeling and statistical analysis Experience with market risk and mortgage-related modeling and analytics strongly preferred Must have strong programming skills in Python and SQL. Familiarity with other languages such as Java, C++, MATLAB, SAS useful. Keys to Success in this Role: Strong programming skills Strong technical skills Strong analytical skills with orientation to detail Excellent verbal and written communication skills Current Freddie Mac employees please apply through the internal career site. We consider all applicants for all positions without regard to gender, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, physical and mental disability, pregnancy, ethnicity, genetic information or any other protected categories under applicable federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Asset Management Analyst
jobs.jd: Job Seekers can review the Job Applicant Privacy Policy by clicking here . Job Description : Summary - The Asset Management Analyst position is designed to execute enhanced asset management processes that pertain to our fleet management and revenue monitoring activities. Primarily, this individual will provide support for the asset team through data and analytics. The primary goal of the Asset Management Analyst is to provide enhanced asset analysis to provide a better customer experience and to support growth initiatives and increase sales. This position will also be responsible for the execution of projects within Asset Management that are key to orchestrating execution plans and ensure accountability through cross-functional ownership. This position will also promote Asset Management fundamentals and principles within the FMS and Dedicated Organization. Essential Functions Responsible for Fleet Management. Works on Redeployment of Assets within Asset team to prevent units from becoming NLE (No Longer Earning) Works cross functionally with other teams to achieve accurate tracking and reporting of our assets. Create exception reporting to support Asset Management initiatives. Drive special projects as a lead analyst based on Asset Management needs Additional Responsibilities Sales and Marketing: Track redeployment of vehicles from reserving to in service of unit to the Customer with coordination with the local AM with reporting and AM centered programs (AMP) DTS Support: Coordinate and assist with key initiatives under the DTS product offering as needed. Asset Management: Fulfill asset requests, Manage Rent to Lease (R2L), Manage Surplus Vehicle Notice (SVN), Vehicle Change Notice (VCN) Monitor Account I/S & O/S to control NYE and NLE s. Attend calls weekly to prevent billing errors on end bills and start bills. Financial: Review and conduct analysis of Fleet, Less than term, Flex Lease , Short Term Lease, Fast Track, Vosa while ensuring proper depreciation to salvage during the life of the asset working in tandem with local AM’s Creative Solutioning: providing insight and navigating a plan of action to achieve AM goals. jobs.title: Treasury Digital Assets Analyst
jobs.jd: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Join Visa Treasury's Digital Assets and Innovation team to help reshape how money moves with digital assets like stablecoins and next-gen payment rails. In this role, you'll own operations end to end, develop treasury roadmaps, and guide decisions, partnering with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Settlement Ops, Finance, and Product to vet ideas and design and launch pilots with external partners. You'll keep a close pulse on the crypto ecosystem and turn research into clear recommendations. We're looking for someone who brings big ideas and takes ownership, yet stays grounded in treasury fundamentals like liquidity, settlement, reconciliation, and controls. This role is perfect if you're ready to roll up your sleeves, move fast, and help define the next chapter of money movement at Visa. Key Responsibilities: Run daily treasury operations across digital assets and traditional payments, including cash, liquidity, settlement, and reconciliation. Execute treasury activities across blockchains, custodians, wallets, banks, exchanges, and payment providers. Participate in a rotating weekend and after-hours support model for critical treasury operations and incident response. Monitor fiat and digital asset liquidity, funding needs, and operational risk controls. Support stablecoin operations, including minting, redemption, custody transfers, wallet funding, and exception management. Own settlement, reconciliation, operational controls, audit readiness, and issue resolution processes. Improve runbooks, procedures, controls, and escalation frameworks. Track KPIs and operational metrics; provide actionable insights to leadership. Assess opportunities and risks across digital asset use cases, focusing on liquidity, efficiency, settlement, and working capital impacts. Monitor developments across blockchain, stablecoin, custody, payments, and regulatory ecosystems. Create executive-ready presentations, strategy memos, and business recommendations. Lead pilot execution from planning through launch, including governance, testing, vendor diligence, and operational readiness. Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to build scalable solutions. Support selection and evaluation of custody, wallet, banking, payment, and blockchain infrastructure providers. This role is a Hybrid position to be located in our Foster City, CA office location. This role requires weekend operations. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 2 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD) Preferred Qualifications: 3 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) Experience in treasury, payments, fintech, consulting, strategy, or operations with cross-functional project delivery. Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Treasury fundamentals: liquidity, cash management, settlement, reconciliation, FX, and working capital. Digital assets: stablecoins, custody, wallets, blockchain networks, transaction fees, and ecosystem participants. Payments: ACH, SWIFT, RTP, FedNow, SEPA Instant, card settlement, and cross-border payments. Incident management, root-cause analysis, and process improvement. Data analysis and reporting using Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Operational controls, governance, audit readiness, and documentation. Executive communication and stakeholder management. Strong project management and cross-functional leadership. High ownership, attention to detail, and ability to balance strategy with execution. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Mental/Physical Requirements This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth
jobs.jd:
About the Team

Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.

About the Role

In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.

A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.

In This Role, You Will:

 - Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth.

 - Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API.

 - Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage.

 - Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider.

 - Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

 - Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest.

 - Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.

Qualifications

 - Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads.

 - Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business.

 - Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.

Prospective Risk Adjustment focuses on proactively supporting opportunities for healthcare providers to review members’ health information and accurately document conditions addressed during clinical care, in accordance with applicable clinical coding and documentation requirements. These efforts may include sharing relevant clinical information with providers at the point of care, conducting virtual or in-home health assessments, and providing reports that identify historical or suspected conditions for provider review and clinical validation. The Analyst, Risk Adjustment supports the day-to-day execution and performance of Prospective Risk Adjustment programs. This role partners with internal teams and external vendors to ensure operational workflows are functioning as intended, program data and reporting are accurate, claims are processed appropriately, and operational issues are identified and resolved in a timely manner. The analyst will support a portfolio of initiatives including Point-of-Care tools, Virtual Health Assessments (VHA), In-Home Assessments (IHA), and provider reporting to support the review of member conditions. This role is well suited for an analytical, detail-oriented professional interested in developing expertise in Risk Adjustment and healthcare operations. You will report into the Sr. Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Risk Adjustment). Support Point-of-Care tools and provider reporting initiatives and assist with resolving related data, reporting, and workflow issues.  - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our Sales Strategy & Operations team and own how ElevenLabs goes to market by vertical. As we shift from a horizontal motion to a vertical-led one, you will go deep on each of our top verticals — the buyer, the use cases, the competitive landscape, and what it takes to win — and turn that into a repeatable playbook for launching and scaling each one.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll sit at the center of the vertical GTM motion, working with Product Marketing, Forward Deployed Engineering, Product, and Sales leadership to define each vertical's strategy, surface product gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment until every vertical is launched and performing. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a new market from the ground up, not maintain an existing one.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - Vertical Deep Dives - Own the research and strategy for each top vertical: market sizing, ICP and persona definition, buying process, priority use cases, competitive positioning, and where ElevenLabs wins.

 - Vertical Launches - Run the end-to-end launch of each vertical, from strategy and segmentation through enablement, pipeline targets, and post-launch performance reviews.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment - Drive alignment across PMM, FDE, Product, Sales, and Marketing on vertical priorities, owners, and timelines. Be the single thread that keeps every function moving in the same direction.

 - Product Needs - Dig deep into what each vertical requires from the product — integrations, compliance, features, workflows, and translate field signal into prioritized, evidence-backed requirements for Product.

 - Data-Driven Strategy - Define the metrics that matter for each vertical (pipeline, win rate, ACV, sales cycle, product adoption), build the dashboards, and use the insights to decide where to double down or pull back.

 - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and GTM leadership on where to invest by vertical, with clear recommendations and regular performance reporting.
   
   

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.
   
   

What you bring

 - 4+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations or GTM strategy, ideally with experience building or launching a vertical GTM motion

 - Proven track record of taking an ambiguous strategic question to a structured answer, then driving execution across teams.

 - Deep curiosity about industries — you enjoy learning how a healthcare, financial services, or retail buyer actually operates and what they need

 - Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to align Product, Marketing, and Sales leaders without direct authority.

jobs.jd:
Hi, We're Centerfield!

Supercharged customer acquisition. Centerfield delivers outcome-based digital marketing solutions and personalized omnichannel experiences for the world’s leading brands. Powered by our proprietary Dugout platform, Centerfield acquires customers at scale for leading residential service, insurance, e-commerce, and B2B brands. Centerfield’s digital experiences and digital brands, such as Business.com http://Business.com and BroadbandNow.com http://BroadbandNow.com, reach more than 150 million in-market shoppers annually. Centerfield is headquartered in Silicon Beach and is proud to be recognized by Built in LA as a Best Place to Work in Los Angeles.


ROLE OVERVIEW...

We’re looking for a Data Scientist with 2+ years of experience to turn complex data into models, insights, and recommendations that improve business performance. You’ll tackle problems involving customer behavior, marketing effectiveness, sales conversion, and forecasting, partnering with business stakeholders, data engineers, and machine learning engineers.

This role combines a strong foundation in statistics and machine learning with the ability to apply AI and large language models (LLMs) to practical business problems.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES...

 - Partner with marketing, sales, and operations teams to define business problems, establish success metrics, and identify opportunities to improve conversion, revenue, and efficiency.

 - Explore and combine data from multiple sources using SQL and Python. Investigate data quality issues, develop features, and document assumptions.

 - Build and evaluate predictive models for use cases such as customer propensity, lifetime value, segmentation, and forecasting.

 - Apply statistical analysis and experimentation to understand performance drivers, measure impact, and communicate uncertainty and limitations.

 - Develop reusable analytical workflows and automate recurring analyses to support faster, more consistent decision-making.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate models into business workflows and monitor their performance over time.

 - Apply AI and LLMs to use cases such as extracting insights from unstructured data and supporting analytical workflows. Evaluate output quality, reliability, cost, and appropriate handling of data.

 - Present findings to technical and nontechnical audiences, explain trade-offs, and recommend clear next steps.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES...

 - 2+ years of experience in data science or a closely related role applying statistical analysis and machine learning to business problems.

 - Strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python for data preparation, analysis, modeling, and evaluation.

 - A solid foundation in statistics and machine learning, including regression, classification, clustering, and hypothesis testing.

 - Experience with feature engineering, model validation, and selecting appropriate evaluation metrics, including an understanding of overfitting and data leakage.

 - Ability to work with AI and LLMs, demonstrated through professional, academic, or personal projects. Familiarity with prompting, working with model outputs, and evaluating their accuracy and reliability.

 - Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into a structured analytical approach and actionable recommendations.

 - Attention to data quality, reproducibility, and documentation, with familiarity using version control.

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.


BONUS POINTS...

 - Experience with GCP, BigQuery, or comparable cloud data platforms.

 - Experience in digital marketing, customer acquisition, sales, or customer analytics.

 - Experience with forecasting, propensity modeling, customer lifetime value, or experiment design.

 - Familiarity with LLM APIs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or evaluating AI-powered applications.

 - Experience partnering with engineering teams to deploy and monitor models.

jobs.jd: We're looking for a Pricing Strategy Analyst to join Procore's Corporate Strategy team. In this role, you'll be the data and analytics engine behind our pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy, turning transaction, sales, and product data into the commercial signals that inform our decisions. You'll also lead smaller pricing initiatives across the full Procore portfolio, including our emerging AI offerings. The primary goal of this role is to make sure Procore's pricing decisions are grounded in clear, accurate, and well-sourced data. As a Pricing Strategy Analyst , you'll partner with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing to analyze how our pricing and packaging perform in the market and to build the visibility needed to improve them. Use your structured problem-solving, data analysis, and executive communication skills to shape how Procore captures value from what we build and buy. If you want hands-on work to drive top line growth and connect everyone in construction, apply today and join our team! This position reports to the Senior Manager of Pricing & Monetization Strategy and can be based remotely in the US. We're looking for someone to join us immediately. What you'll do: Lead pricing and packaging initiatives from hypothesis through recommendation, in partnership with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing Build and stress-test the business case behind pricing decisions, including segment-level performance, cannibalization-adjusted ARR impact, and migration and monetization sizing. Design and run market, competitive, and willingness-to-pay research, including win/loss and price elasticity analysis, to pressure-test pricing hypotheses before they reach leadership. Build and maintain pricing and packaging reporting and dashboards that give Product, Sales, and Finance visibility into performance, working with data teams to keep metrics and data sources accurate and consistent. Translate analysis into a small number of clear, claim-driven recommendations, present them to executive leaders, and defend them under challenge. Partner with Pricing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Deal Desk, and Marketing to make sure approved decisions are operationalized and communicated to the field. What we’re looking for: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in pricing, monetization, strategy, business or data analytics, financial planning and analysis, or consulting wi th 2+ y ears inside a pricing or monetization practice at a top-tier strategy firm Track record of framing ambiguous problems into clear analytical frameworks and presenting recommendations to cross-functional and senior audiences. Experience leading projects or workstreams from analysis through recommendation, with the ability to balance multiple priorities. Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with experience building revenue impact and unit economics models. Hands-on experience querying and analyzing large datasets (e.g., SQL), building reports in a BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus Ability to synthesize qualitative inputs, such as call transcripts and field feedback, into clear themes that support pricing recommendations. Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills, with experience partnering with Product, Sales, Finance, and Marketing teams. Familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics (e.g., ARR, net revenue retention, win rate, discount rate) is a plus Curiosity, high agency, and an owner’s mindset with a strong bias for action. jobs.jd:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.




COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.




TEAM OVERVIEW

Marketing Operations keeps Deepgram's go-to-market engine measurable. As our first Marketing & GTM Data Analyst, you'll build the reporting and analytics function rather than inherit a finished one, and own the answer to what's working and where to invest next. You'll partner with the Director of Marketing Operations on the weekly GTM report leadership reads, and with our Decision Intelligence and Data Engineering teams on AI analytics agents and the GTM data foundation. Your work will power Marketing, Product, SDR, AE, Partnerships, and RevOps.




KEY GOALS

 - Automate recurring GTM analytics with Decision Intelligence, designing and improving AI agents for weekly reporting, campaign and sales play readouts, scoring-model checks, and anomaly alerts, as the GTM expert who writes evaluation cases and QAs their output.

 - Own Marketing and GTM KPI definitions, calculation logic, and the weekly report leadership reads, with a clear narrative on what changed and why.

 - Measure marketing campaigns and SDR/AE sales plays from first touch through closed-won, using pre/post and cohort analysis to say what to scale, fix, or stop.

 - Create reusable campaign and sales play reporting templates with consistent definitions, time windows, and attribution rules, structured so AI agents can generate first drafts.
